rationale: The admitted L3 adapter is intentionally disposable, always restores exact preimage bytes, removes its complete directory, rejects live mode, and records runtime_activated false. A new non-live state-bearing local sandbox successor is therefore the smallest non-vacuous direction that can prove surviving activation state without introducing credentials, network, service, production-data, or live-system effects.

minimum_boundary: adapter-owned sandbox root with explicit lifecycle
state survives a bounded activation observation
explicit teardown restores or removes all sandbox state
product_direction.reversibility: A later explicit owner decision may supersede this product direction; this decision and its exact candidate remain immutable history.

non_effects: This decision does not mutate the frozen target-selection candidate, admissibility records, L3 admission, test evidence, or implementation bytes.
This decision does not define or bind the successor implementation identity.
This decision does not start or complete prototype construction.
This decision does not freeze, test, approve, or admit a successor product.
This decision does not activate a runtime or make live execution ready.
This decision does not authorize migration, cutover, publication, release, or deployment.
This decision does not grant credentials, destructive action, or external effects.
claim_ceiling: The owner selected a new non-live state-bearing local sandbox target as the L4 product direction. Prototype construction may proceed only through its separate implementation route with a new identity and digest. No implementation has started, and no successor product is frozen, tested, approved, admitted, or activated; no live execution, migration, cutover, publication, deployment, credential, destructive action, or external effect is authorized or performed.
